data.narrative:
Zephyr Fusion is a Pre-Seed nuclear energy company founded by two plasma physics researchers with 15+ and 20+ years of experience respectively at national laboratories. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 nuclear energy firms: 3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 6 private peers including Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy. The company has raised $500K to date.

The analysis applies stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using the $500K total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Pre-Seed to next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $1.25M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable: while 5 nuclear energy peers exist in the comp set, none yielded three or more datapoints within the narrow filters of same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier. A broader all-sector median would introduce unacceptable bias.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.06M to $1.44M, centered on $1.25M. This reflects stage-based progression alone and carries material uncertainty around (1) absence of comparable-stage peer pricing, (2) limited revenue or technical validation milestones disclosed, and (3) founder track record not yet reflected in operational metrics. The range should be revisited with additional peer data or near-term technical/commercial de-risking events.
